title: Landplot map creation - Quick and Easy
excerpt: The "Quickland Plot" tool is built on the philosophy of "Design Smarter, Work Faster". It aims to empower users—especially those who may not be experts in complex GIS software—to produce high-quality, standardized land maps quickly while maintaining high data integrity.
tip: The input data can either be existing polygon feature, existing line feature, point boundary, or csv table containing xy coordinate of the boundary.
body:
Tired of spending hours manually drawing boundaries, setting up labels, and designing map layouts? We have the perfect solution for you! In this video, we introduce the "Quickland Plot" tool—a powerful feature of the KGA Toolbox designed to automate your GIS workflow and save you valuable time. ⏱️✨

✅ What can this tool do for you?

Automatic Geometry: Convert your raw data (Points, Lines, or Polygons) into a complete land parcel map instantly.
One-Click Mapping: Just select your input, click "Run," and let the toolbox handle the rest.
Professional Output: Automatically generates layouts, coordinate tables, and symbology with high precision.
Work Smarter: Designed for both GIS experts and those new to the software to produce high-quality results.


Below are step-by-step guide to use this tool
steps:
Choose Input type
Specify output workspace
Add map title (optional)
Add address sub-title (optional)
Set grid interval
Choose to open the map

title: Label Expression Builder - No Code need - Easy and Save time
excerpt: The Label Control tool is a specialized feature within the KGA Toolbox for ArcGIS Pro. It transforms the way GIS professionals handle labeling by replacing manual Python, VBScript, or Arcade coding with an intuitive, "no-code" graphical user interface.
tip: Select layer where label expression will be build, then click the button to open the tool.
body:
Key Features & Workflow

No-Code Label Generation The core value of this utility is its ability to generate complex label expressions through simple UI selections. Users can pick fields (e.g., Owner Name, Area) from a dropdown menu, eliminating the need to write syntax manually.

Dynamic Formatting Controls 

  • - Font Customization: Users can instantly adjust font sizes, colors, and styles (such as Bold or Italic) for individual parts of the label.
  • - Multi-Line Labels: The interface allows for the creation of multi-line labels, enabling different attributes to appear on separate lines with distinct formatting for each.

Real-Time Feedback Loop

Expression Preview: As users interact with the UI, the tool displays the "Current Label Expression" in real-time, showing the background code it is generating.

  • - Visual Preview: A dedicated preview window shows exactly how the text will appear on the map, allowing for immediate adjustments before applying the changes.

Efficiency and Precision By automating the inclusion of separators and special characters—which are often prone to syntax errors when typed manually—the tool ensures the label expression is valid every time.
Continuous Improvement This utility is part of an evolving ecosystem, with ongoing updates and feature expansions planned to further streamline GIS cartography and annotation tasks.

title: Quick Feature Overlap Detection
excerpt:
Quick Overlap Detection Tool - Find Overlap 
Available in KGAToolbox Addin for ArcGIS Pro v2016.1.3
tip: Select polygon layer in the content, click the button and you get the result.
body: Find Overlap tool, a new feature added to the KG Toolbox for ArcGIS Pro designed to quickly identify boundary errors in spatial data. By selecting a layer and running the tool, the system automatically scans for overlapping polygons and generates visual error markers, even for tiny overlaps that are difficult to see manually.
